mechanism: Both drugs are CYP3A4 substrates; everolimus may increase eplerenone levels, and both agents can cause hyperkalemia through different mechanisms (eplerenone as potassium-sparing agent, everolimus through renal effects).
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider eplerenone dose adjustment if co-administered; counsel on potassium-rich foods and NSAIDs avoidance.
